name: Guns of Gamara
source:
Set in the Evil Altean Reality (S3ep4), you are part of the Guns of Gamara fighting against the Evil Altean Empire!

You are waking up in a healing pod! But what happened to you!?

Choose who you are to find out, in two different storylines!

Your boyfriend is so happy to see you out of the healing pod!

[From [url=https://www.tumblr.com/littlecofieart/184154283798/the-guns-of-gamara-visual-novel-is-here-set-in]Tumblr[/url]]
translation:
以邪恶阿尔泰现实（S3ep4）为背景，你是加马拉之枪的一员，与邪恶阿尔泰帝国作战！

你在治疗舱中醒来！但你怎么了！？

在两个不同的故事情节中选择你要找出的身份！

你的男朋友很高兴看到你走出治疗舱！

[来自[url=https://www.tumblr.com/littlecofieart/184154283798/the-guns-of-gamara-visual-novel-is-here-set-in]Tumblr[/url]]
